title: Explainer provenance block v1
description: The `explainer` frontmatter block that ties a hand-authored explainer document to the scenarios it explains. See the explain-change skill.

generated.description: ISO date the explainer was generated (YYYY-MM-DD).

runId.description: runId of the run the explainer was generated from.

title.description: Scenario title at generation time; enables rename detection.

hash.description: scenarioContentHash at generation time (16 hex chars of sha256 over title + step keywords/texts).
